evidence.quote:
Every new hire completes the Pallasine checklist in their first
week

observations.why: Stating a mandatory process as established fact invokes the authority of an agreed-upon procedure without explicit pressure or persuasion.

evidence.quote:
It replaced the
old wiki page last quarter

observations.why: Supplying a factual timeline about a process change positions the speaker as a controller of organizational knowledge, but no influence attempt is performed on an audience.
